Order with signature of Judge, and that of haa Proceeding Parties’ counsel, where necessary proceeding 06.12.2022 Sardar Muhammad Ashraf Khan Sargana, Advocate for petitioner. Mr. Attiq-ur-Rehman Sheikh, Advocate for respondent Nos. 4 to 7. Through this constitutional _ petition petitioner has prayed as under: “In view of the above submission, it is therefore, respectfully prayed that the writ petition may kindly be accepted and the impugned judgment dated 16.03.2022 regarding meters reference No. 08 11712 1020131U and 08 11712 1018302U may | kindly be declared illegal, void and without lawful i authority in the large interest of justice while | operation of impugned judgments may kindly be | suspended during the pendency of titled writ | petition. It is further may kindly be requested that the | respondent no 3 to 7 my kindly be directed to restore meter reference no 08 11712 1020131U and 08 11712 1018302U in the large interest of justice. Any other relief which is just and proper may kindly be awarded to the petitioner in the interest of justice and equity.”

Through order dated 16.03.2022 passed by learned Addl. District Judge matter was remanded to learned trial court by setting aside the order directing restoration of meter passed by trial court dated 19.01.2022 to decide the application of interim relief filed by petitioner afresh, in compliance of which order was passed by the trial court on 16.05.2022 before this constitution petition was filed, whereas this petition was taken up for initial hearing on 24.06.2022. Operative part of order dated 16.05.2022 is reproduced as under: WP. No. 40040 of 2022 2 “ is a The petitioner was granted ad interim injunction subject to deposit the bills, the same has been complying as a gesture of petitioner's bona fide. The petitioner has good prima facie arguable case. Balance of convenience also lies in his, favour. If at this stage his connection or supply is disconnected, he would have to cause irreparable loss. The matter requires consideration and same must be decided after recording of evidence in these circumstances, the petition under Order XXXIX Rule 1 & 2 C.P.C. is accepted subject to direction to the petitioner to deposit of the total disputed bill & the current electricity bill of each month regularly. In case of violence the Court’s direction regarding paying of bill total disputed bill, respondents would be at liberty to proceed in accordance with law. The amount of arrear shall be treated as mad-e-Amanat and the same be decided at the time of final decision after recording of evidence of the parties. No order as to costs. The order be annexed to main file.”

As the impugned order dated 16.03.2022 had already been implemented by the trial court and fresh order had been passed, hence, this petition has become infructuous and cannot proceed and the petitioner has remedy available against the fresh order passed by the trial court. Therefore, as the situation has changed, petitioner may seek appropriate remedy before appropriate forum in accordance with law.
With the above said observation, this constitutional petition is disposed of. ' (Muzamil Akhtar Shabir) Muzaitbnen Judge
